rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: This MCP server provides a complete HR management system built on SQLite, offering tools for employee lifecycle management, organizational structure, leave management, salary administration, and performance tracking. The implementation includes two specialized clients: a basic client for general database operations and an enhanced HR client with natural language processing that interprets user queries and automatically selects appropriate tools based on context. The server supports complex HR workflows including employee onboarding with automatic department/position creation, leave balance calculations with pro-rating, organizational hierarchy visualization, and comprehensive audit logging, making it suitable for small to medium businesses needing a self-contained HR management solution with AI-powered natural language interfaces.
